title: Automating Feature Flag Cleanup at Scale with Multi-Agent LLM Systems: An Industrial Experience at DoorDash
abstract: arXiv:2610.31351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feature flags are runtime configuration mechanisms used for gradual feature rollouts, experimentation, and kill switches. Once a feature is fully rolled out, the flag and its gated code become technical debt and can introduce operational risk through inadvertently enabling dormant code paths. At DoorDash, over 56,000 feature flags span 623 repositories, with 1,659 currently stale as of May 2026, with internal estimates of one to two hours per manual cleanup. Existing rule-based cleanup tools proved insufficient in DoorDash's codebases. Our contribution is an end-to-end automated LLM-based feature flag cleanup system that integrates querying live feature flag rollout data using MCP, Jira ticket processing, and end-to-end pull request creation. Our system successfully produced engineer-approved flag removal PRs for 45 (90%) of the 50 stale flags it was evaluated on, proving the system's operational viability at scale with each cleanup aver

translated_title: 使用多智能体LLM系统大规模自动化功能开关清理：DoorDash的工业实践经验
translated_abstract: 功能开关（Feature flags）是一种运行时配置机制，用于渐进式功能发布、实验和紧急关闭开关。一旦功能完全发布，该开关及其控制的代码就会成为技术债务，并可能通过意外启用休眠代码路径而引入运营风险。在DoorDash，超过56,000个功能开关分布在623个代码仓库中，截至2026年5月，目前有1,659个处于过期状态，内部估计每次手动清理需要一到两个小时。现有的基于规则的清理工具在DoorDash的代码库中被证明是不够的。我们的贡献是一个端到端的基于LLM的自动化功能开关清理系统，它集成了使用MCP查询实时功能开关发布数据、Jira工单处理以及端到端的拉取请求创建。我们的系统在评估的50个过期开关中成功产生了45个（90%）获得工程师批准的开关删除PR，证明了该系统在大规模运营中的可行性，每次清理平均……
tldr: 本文提出一个基于多智能体LLM的端到端自动化功能开关清理系统，在DoorDash的大规模工业实践中，对评估的50个过期功能开关中90%成功生成了获得工程师批准的删除PR。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end automated multi-agent LLM-based feature flag cleanup system that successfully generated engineer-approved removal PRs for 90% of the stale flags evaluated at DoorDash's industrial scale.
